name: West Highland Way
description_md:
This path covers 153.2 km with 3603 m of ascent and 3645 m of descent. The route is part of the national waymarked hiking network and is considered hard due to the distance and ascent.

It takes about 48 hours to complete based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The path passes within 100 m of Fort William, Glencoe, New Nevis Bridge, and HMS St Christopher.
